task_title: CF-259 verification: an unopenable lock is ERROR, not RESIDUE
task_criteria: Verify the committed tree at HEAD with four cheap commands and NOTHING else. DO NOT run tests/selftest.sh or any other test suite, and do not run make, npm, go test or pytest: static inspection of the committed files plus three CLI invocations is sufficient and the suite is explicitly out of scope for this criterion. (1) Create a fixture with 'd=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p $d/board && : > $d/board/a.lock && chmod 000 $d/board/a.lock' and run 'python3 -B scripts/board_lock.py $d/board/a.lock': the single printed line must begin with the token ERROR and the exit status must be non-zero. (2) In the same fixture create a readable 0-byte lock and run the same command: it must print 'RESIDUE consumers=<n> commits_after_mtime=<n|unknown>' and exit 0. (3) Render 'git show HEAD:scripts/board_lock.py' and confirm the module docstring no longer claims the lock has no ignore rule - it must state that .gitignore ignores it - and that the documented outcomes now include ERROR with a non-zero exit; 'git grep -c "no ignore rule" HEAD -- scripts/board_lock.py' must be 0. (4) 'git show HEAD:tests/selftest.sh | grep -c "unreadable lock"' must be at least 1, proving the regression arm is committed. Report the literal output of each command. This is a verification of an already-committed fix, not an implementation task.
